title: A profile of DDN, a managed data storage company whose annual revenue is expected to grow from $300M pre-AI boom to $1B by year's end, fueled by AI partnerships (Iain Martin/Forbes)
summary: Iain Martin / Forbes: A profile of DDN, a managed data storage company whose annual revenue is expected to grow from $300M pre-AI boom to $1B by year's end, fueled by AI partnerships — For nearly three decades, Alex Bouzari ran a data storage stalwart for research labs at the likes of NASA.
